rule: Claims must be filed within 12 months of the date of service.
Outpatient physical therapy services need modifier GP.
CLIA waived lab tests done in the office need modifier QW.
Timed therapy codes follow the 8 minute rule: 8 to 22 min = 1 unit, 23 to 37 min = 2 units, 38 to 52 min = 3 units.
Routine physicals (99381 to 99397) are not covered. The Annual Wellness Visit uses G0438 or G0439.
A screening colonoscopy that becomes diagnostic or therapeutic is billed with modifier PT and Z12.11 first.
Medicare IDs are 11 characters and never use the letters S, L, O, I, B, or Z.
If the patient or spouse is still working and covered by a large employer plan, that plan pays first.
Drugs given in the office need the 11 digit NDC on the claim.
Claims must be filed within 180 days of the date of service.
MRI, CT, knee arthroscopy (29881), and sleep studies (95810) need prior authorization.

Specialist visits need a PCP referral number on the claim.
Claims must be filed within 90 days of the date of service.
Telehealth visits with place of service 10 need modifier 95.
Claims must be filed within 120 days of the date of service.
An office visit on the same day as a minor procedure needs modifier 25 if the visit was a separate, significant service.
Injury codes (S and T codes) need a 7th character such as A for the initial encounter.
The diagnosis laterality (right or left) must match the procedure modifier (RT or LT).
